w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Everett is calling it "Old Gavel." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE TERMS OF SERVICE! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Ad Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 17 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

windowEndGuard: not-ready:Finish the current encounter before taking your seat.
auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/8/6), with 4 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 5 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Oliver Moore reached into the light and the light reached back — person and machine, two caretakers, holding the channel open between them both ways. The village endures, and the conversation does not end.
